text_block_list.text:
O-O-Opera O, today we're having a
sh-show!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
O-O-Opera O, are we having a
sh-showdown
today?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Japan Cup. Over at
the
paddock...
O-O-Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: What is it, Doto?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Today, we're having a... having a...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: SHOWDOOOWN!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
All our practice comes to
fruition—Мэйсё Дото
successfully
establishes their rivalry.

I can't believe my ears! Doto... what are
you
saying?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Why? My most beloved subject has
chosen to
betray me?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Waaagh! She's mad... Opera O is really
mad...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I know not mercy! Anger, rage, broils
within me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My head burns, burns, burns! Ready to
explode! If
it's a showdown you want, a
showdown you will
get! ♪ (You will
geeet!)
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
In comes an impromptu musical show. I
figured
the news wouldn't be enough to
phase her.

Doto! Are you sure this is what you
want? To
enter the Japan Cup not as my
comrade, but as
my enemy?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes... And I will definitely win against
you,
Opera O!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Then, stand against me
with all
your might. My Overlord dash
will cut you to
pieces!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I w-won't let that happen. I'll zoom right
past you!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Things are heating up from all the
theatrics. The
crowd must be feeling the
change in attitude.

Well, Doto, I'm more than happy to
oblige. Give
me everything you've got.
However...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Know I'm not a fan of half-hearted
performances.
I won't let you off easy,
should you not fulfill my
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: U-understood!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
